prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a low-speed head-on collision in Pasadena, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1066; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but I can confirm I'm the driver of the vehicle involved.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was heading east on the main road in Pasadena, Texas, approaching the intersection near the shopping center. It was a clear afternoon.

Q: What was your speed at the time of impact?
A: I'd say maybe fifteen or twenty miles an hour. I was slowing down for traffic ahead.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the collision?
A: Not really. It came across the center line very quickly, and I braked and turned, but there wasn't much time.

Q: Did your airbags deploy?
A: Yes, the airbag went off. My head hit the side window and then the steering wheel area, I think.

Q: Did you lose consciousness, even briefly?
A: I don't think I passed out completely, but everything went blurry and I felt disoriented for a few minutes.

Q: How are you feeling now?
A: I've got a bad headache, I'm sensitive to light, and I feel foggy when I try to concentrate. The doctor said I have a concussion.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the accident?
A: Yes, I was taken to the emergency room and I've had two follow-up appointments with my primary care physician. I'm also supposed to see a neurologist.

Q: Has anyone else been injured in the collision?
A: I'm not sure. The other driver seemed shaken up, but I didn't see the extent of it.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm still having trouble working on the computer for long periods, so I'm keeping in touch with my employer about time off.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
